watches.name: Discobolo Jade acciaio
watches.description: With the Discobolo , Zannetti reinvents the flying saucer, giving it a typically Classical and Roman style. The engravings on the inner border, the ones on the back and the entirely handmade dial with translucent enamels make it a real unique piece result of the best professionals hands. Simple and sophisticated at the same time, it is a high watchmaking piece, where creativity and craftsmanship are fused to realizing an object of this kind. For each piece is required the knowledge of Art Masters, Engravers, Enamellers, Miniaturists and Watchmakers. The result is unique, each piece different from the others, reason why the production is naturally limited since it would be impossible to create more than two Discobolo a month, for a total amount of twenty pieces a year. Case: -Stainless steel case with satin finish; -45mm diameter; -Stainless steel rear; -Sapphire glass; -Invisible strap holder, located underneath the middle case. Dial: -Jade dial. -Translucent enamels; -Luminescent markers on hand and indexes; -Antireflectant treatment. Movement: -Swiss-made automatic ETA movement modified by Zannetti. Weight: 0.105gr. watches.name: Regent Bas-Relief – Red Dragon

Since Neolithic’s faience to archaic bronzes and the Shang’s jades (XVI-XI b.C.), this theme has been reproduced with a constant and endless insistence: we can find it in pottery, lacquers, ceremonial clothing, theaters ceilings, garden’s enclosures, ink drawings.. Zannetti decided to represent the Dragon and his strength on his Regent Watch Collection not only to honor a good-luck and prosperity symbol, but also because the figure’s beauty and fierceness. The engravings on the inner border, the ones on the back and the entirely handmade dial with translucent enamels make it a real unique piece result of the best professionals hands. Simple and sophisticated at the same time, it is a high watchmaking piece, where creativity and craftsmanship are fused to realizing an object of this kind.For each piece is required the knowledge of Art Masters, Engravers, Enamellers, Miniaturists and Watchmakers. The result is unique, each piece different from the others, reason why the production is naturally limited since it would be impossible to create more than two Discobolo a month, for a total amount of twenty pieces a year. watches.name: Pilot Skull “Silver”
watches.description: The skull, being elected by all nowadays teenagers as their favourite break-with-tradition expressive element, actually exists in watchmaking since a long time. There is certainly a long-lasting tradition of “memento mori” watches in history: stories are told that even Maria Stuarda, Queen of Scotland, spent her time in Fotheringhway prison (while waiting Elisabeth I to decide to execute her) playing with her own watch sculpted with a “head” shape. Luckily today its symbolical meaning has changed and to wear an innocent skull on a wrist is merely an exaggerate way to exorcise the future or mostly to break, even only with a design, the mass schemes. This is exactly the reason why Zannetti chose the skull for some of his most exclusive watch collections, characterized by a hand-made production and use of craftsmanship to express his creativity and dexterity at best. Handmade skull in silver and copper. Swiss quartz movement in the back. Limited edition.

watches.name: Discobolo Lady – Blue Enamel & Stainless Steel Case
watches.description: With the Discobolo , Zannetti reinvents the flying saucer, giving it a typically Classical and Roman style. The engravings on the inner border, the ones on the back and the entirely handmade dial with translucent enamels make it a real unique piece result of the best professionals hands. Simple and sophisticated at the same time, it is a high watchmaking piece, where creativity and craftsmanship are fused to realizing an object of this kind. For each piece is required the knowledge of Art Masters, Engravers, Enamellers, Miniaturists and Watchmakers. The result is unique, each piece different from the others, reason why the production is naturally limited since it would be impossible to create more than two Discobolo a month, for a total amount of twenty pieces a year. Case: -Stainless steel case with satin finish; -39mm diameter; -Stainless steel rear; -Sapphire glass; -Invisible strap holder, located underneath the middle case. Dial: -Translucent enamels; -Luminescent markers on hand and indexes. -Antireflectant treatment. Movement: -Swiss-made automatic ETA movement modified by Zannetti. Weight: 1,20 Kg. Luxury package included.
